# AfterTaxTool

AfterTaxTool is a web-based salary after tax and take-home pay resource for UK and US salary earners. It provides calculators, salary examples, payroll explainers, planning guides and transparent methodology notes.

Homepage: https://aftertaxtool.com/
UK salary after tax: https://aftertaxtool.com/salary-after-tax-uk.html
US salary after tax: https://aftertaxtool.com/salary-after-tax-us.html
US salary by state: https://aftertaxtool.com/salary-after-tax-by-state.html
Planning calculators: https://aftertaxtool.com/planning-calculators.html
Salary guides: https://aftertaxtool.com/salary-guides.html
Methodology: https://aftertaxtool.com/methodology.html
Tax assumptions: https://aftertaxtool.com/tax-assumptions.html
Editorial standards: https://aftertaxtool.com/editorial-standards.html

Key explanatory resources:
- Gross vs net pay: https://aftertaxtool.com/gross-vs-net-pay.html
- Payroll deductions: https://aftertaxtool.com/payroll-deduction-guides.html
- Benefits and total compensation: https://aftertaxtool.com/total-compensation-guides.html
- Salary increases: https://aftertaxtool.com/salary-increase-calculator.html
- Job offer decisions: https://aftertaxtool.com/job-offer-salary-calculators.html
